plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) to zero for capital preservation.
Sell SMCI as it is below its stop and flagged for exit.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name mandate.
Trim SMH to 5% due to its downtrend and to reduce sector concentration.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5%/month return, prioritizing capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by cutting leveraged positions and trimming concentrations. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL and METU to small allocations, and sell SPAL and MUU to zero to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Sell SMCI as it is below its stop and flagged for exit.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name mandate.
Add to SNOW, a strong scanner setup, to balance growth with risk management.
This plan aims for risk-first growth with a blend of broad index and quality tech.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, aiming for growth while managing risk. It reduces overall leverage and concentration, blending broad market exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and a balanced risk-reward profile.

plan: Add to SOXL, METU, and MUU to increase leveraged ETF exposure, adhering to the combined limit.
Sell SMCI as it is below its stop and flagged for exit.
Trim QQQI to 20% to meet the single name mandate.
Add to SNOW and buy TSM, both strong scanner setups, to concentrate in high-scoring opportunities.
This plan aims for aggressive growth by leveraging high-conviction setups.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretched growth. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, which raises both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware that leveraged ETFs decay daily, and this approach can lead to significant losses quickly if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, METU, MUU, SPAL) to zero to prioritize low drawdown.
Sell SMCI as it is below its stop and flagged for exit.
Add to QQQI, increasing its allocation to 30% for enhanced monthly distributions.
Trim SMH to 5% to reduce high-beta exposure and further de-risk the portfolio.
This plan focuses on generating steady income with a low-volatility profile.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions and capital preservation. It significantly reduces exposure to high-beta and leveraged assets. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market downturns; this is not a savings account.
